- docs/INVENTORY.md:236-238, 257-259 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: Three script paths are documented twice in the Scripts section.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` rejects duplicate script entries, and reviewers report that the CI check has failed on these paths.
- agents.md:1085-1096 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: New documentation was added directly to `agents.md` instead of through an `agents.d/` fragment.
  WHY: Reviewers report that the agents.md direct-edit check rejects these additions, failing `static-checks`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_apply_fixes.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_validate_editor_noop.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_ready_to_merge.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh:whole files | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Four added step scripts are not invoked by the workflow or registered for staging and testing, leaving duplicate or intended-to-be-moved implementations dead.
  WHY: Changes to these files have no runtime effect and can drift from the live workflow implementations; severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated this NIT, while the highest rating was MAJOR.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_ready_to_merge.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh:set_issue_phase_label_resilient | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The label-writing fallback bodies omit the idempotent flag for POST requests.
  WHY: A transient API error can leave the issue without its phase label or make a retry behave unexpectedly; severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated this NIT, while google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR.
- changelog.d/6963-auto-merge-required-ci-check.md: "For contributors" paragraph | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contributor paragraph overstates which step bodies this change moved and where they are wired.
  WHY: It can mislead contributors about which scripts are live and what the workflow file-size change shipped; severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this MAJOR, while the highest other ratings were NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: lines 531 and 536 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `reason=ci_run_pending` and `reason=ci_run_cancelled` `AUTOFIX_AUTO_MERGE_CHECKS` log lines lack the `ci_check=<name> ci_state=<state>` fields promised by the header comment.
  WHY: A parser expecting those fields can miss these outcomes and produce incomplete CI-state telemetry.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py, tests/test_review_autofix_last_run_diff_oscillation_guard.py, tests/test_review_commit_new_files_preserved.py, tests/test_review_semble_contract.py, tests/test_review_autofix_phase_transition_contract.py, tests/test_retarget_merged_base.py, tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_state.py, tests/test_review_pr_tree_python_isolation.py, tests/test_touched_set_symlink_aware.py: duplicate import/path-insert lines | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Several test files contain duplicate `import sys`, `sys.path.insert(...)`, and/or `from review_autofix_step_scripts import expanded_review_autofix_text` lines.
  WHY: The duplicates are harmless at runtime but add merge-resolution noise and could fail stricter lint or import-order checks.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: _pr_wait_for_required_checks() (lines 436-464) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The required CI check name is polled through a side-channel lookup and aggregated state, which the reviewer considers redundant and potentially prone to drift.
  WHY: The reviewer describes this as a design/correctness concern rather than a runtime failure.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: _pr_checks_completed() (lines 222-258) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The side-channel aggregation of multiple runs with the same CI check name is complex and coupled with jq.
  WHY: The reviewer considers the added complexity a risk for subtle bugs if check naming conventions or run behaviors change.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Resolve and verify the current PR test-merge commit, poll its required CI check-runs as well as any head-bound checks, and require the configured CI check to exist and succeed."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh::_pr_checks_completed and _pr_wait_for_required_checks
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` queries check-runs on `head_sha` and waits on the reviewed head SHA; no code resolves or polls `merge_commit_sha`. Reviewers note that the PR description records this as a deliberate scope decision because Actions does not register `pull_request` check-runs on the merge commit.
- requirement: "Move the largest inline run: bodies into scripts/ in the same PR".
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` steps and the new `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` files
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow still sources pre-existing scripts or retains inline bodies; the new scripts are unreferenced and are not registered in `tests/review_autofix_step_scripts.py` or `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`.
- requirement: Documentation describing the AUTO_MERGE_REQUIRED_CI_CHECK change must land in `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md`, not directly in `agents.md` (CLAUDE.md §30).
  expected_change_site: agents.d/6963-auto-merge-required-ci-check.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No `agents.d/6963-*.md` fragment exists; the 12 added lines live in agents.md lines 1085-1096, which `scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py` rejects.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/INVENTORY.md: lines 236-238, `review_autofix_step_restore_partial_resume.sh`, `review_autofix_step_generate_diff_context.sh`, `review_autofix_step_preflight_required_files.sh`. The same three scripts are already documented at lines 257-259. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a second INVENTORY bullet for three scripts the Scripts section already lists.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails with "documented in multiple sections (Scripts, Scripts)". The `tests-release-and-log-analysis` check-run has already failed on exactly these three paths.
- agents.md: line 1085, the paragraph "The wait also requires the configured CI check (#6963, ...", under `## Isolated Codex agents`. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds 12 lines to `agents.md` directly instead of an `agents.d/6963-<slug>.md` fragment.
  WHY: The CI step `scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py` fails with `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_EDIT agents.md:1085 adds 12 line(s)...` and a net-add of +12 against a limit of 5.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_apply_fixes.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_validate_editor_noop.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_ready_to_merge.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Four new step scripts are sourced by nothing and are not in `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` or the test registry.
  WHY: Edits to the dead copies change nothing; two duplicate scripts already wired under different names, and the `INVENTORY` lines describe steps as moved that are not.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_ready_to_merge.sh, scripts/review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` fallback bodies omit the idempotent flag from `gh_retry gh api -X POST "repos/${repo}/issues/${issue_number}/labels"`.
  WHY: Once these scripts are wired in, a transient API error leaves the issue without `ai:ready-to-merge` or `ai:review-blocked`. This only matters if someone wires them in.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`, the `reason=ci_run_pending` and `reason=ci_run_cancelled` log lines (about lines 531 and 536). | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: These lines may not carry the new fields promised by the header comment.
  WHY: I did not re-read these two lines in the working tree. I am relying on the pre-pass reviewers' reading that they do not carry the new fields. This is a documentation or consistency issue only, and it has no effect on merge behaviour.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py (lines 38-53), tests/test_review_autofix_last_run_diff_oscillation_guard.py (lines 37-53), tests/test_review_commit_new_files_preserved.py (lines 39-54), tests/test_review_semble_contract.py (lines 6-22), tests/test_review_autofix_phase_transition_contract.py (lines 3-17) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: These files have a second `import sys`, a repeated `sys.path.insert(0, ...)`, and a repeated `from review_autofix_step_scripts import expanded_review_autofix_text`.
  WHY: This is harmless at runtime but adds churn and could trip a stricter linter.
- changelog.d/6963-auto-merge-required-ci-check.md: the "For contributors" paragraph ("eight `codex-agent` step bodies moved verbatim ... 481,544 to 429,786 bytes"). | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only `Decide partial-finalize validation/push safety` is newly wired in the workflow in this PR; the other moved bodies are already wired or have no wrapper.
  WHY: The claim misdescribes what shipped and can mislead operators reading the changelog.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Resolve and verify the current PR test-merge commit, poll its required CI check-runs as well as any head-bound checks, and require the configured CI check to exist and succeed. Do not turn an empty result into merge authorization; retain the reviewed-head binding."
  Expected change site: `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh::_pr_checks_completed` and `_pr_wait_for_required_checks`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR does not resolve or poll `merge_commit_sha`. It queries check-runs only on the head SHA. The PR description records this as a deliberate decision (AD-1: Actions registers `pull_request` check-runs on the head SHA, so polling the merge commit would never see CI). The other two parts of the requirement, the named CI check must exist and succeed, and an empty result no longer authorizes a merge, are implemented. I am citing this for completeness only. I am not asking for a change, and the recorded scope decision stands.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: _pr_wait_for_required_checks() (lines 436-464) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The logic to poll the required CI check name is implemented as a side-channel lookup in _pr_checks_completed, but the implementation is redundant, as it adds logic to aggregate states into PR_CHECKS_LAST_CI_STATE that is then used in _pr_wait_for_required_checks.
  WHY: This is a design/correctness concern rather than a r
